name: Czechia
summary: Since 2026 adults 21+ may hold limited cannabis and grow 3 plants. For other drugs a small amount for own use is a misdemeanour (fine up to CZK 50,000); more is a crime. Any supply is a crime.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law. Paramedics are bound by medical confidentiality and police are not routinely sent to overdoses, but they do attend deaths, violence or public incidents.
drugChecking: No standard drug checking service; some NGOs offer reagent tests at events. The legal status of on-site testing is unclear.

lsd.note: Small amount for own use: misdemeanour (fine up to CZK 50,000). Above a 'small amount' (courts' guide: a few blotters) it is a crime, up to 2 yrs.

mushrooms.note: Small amount or growing a few: misdemeanour. Courts' guide: >40 mushrooms is a crime (up to 1 yr). Spores legal. Medical psilocybin only in clinics since 2026.

dmt.note: DMT is listed. Small amount: misdemeanour fine; more is a crime (up to 2 yrs). Ayahuasca counts as a DMT preparation.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is listed. Small amounts (incl. growing a few cacti for own use) are a misdemeanour; larger amounts are a crime (up to 1–2 yrs).

dox.note: DOB, DOC, DOM etc. are listed. Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine; more is a crime (up to 2 yrs).

nbomes.note: 25I-, 25B-, 25C-NBOMe are listed. Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine; more is a crime (up to 2 yrs).

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are listed. Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine; more is a crime (up to 2 yrs).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are listed. Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine; more is a crime (up to 2 yrs).

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT is not on the main drug lists (2026 check). 5-MeO-MiPT, 5-MeO-DALT and 5-MeO-AMT are listed: small amount = misdemeanour.

cannabis.note: From 1 Jan 2026, 21+: up to 25 g in public, 100 g at home and 3 plants are legal. Up to 50 g/200 g: fine; more is a crime. No legal sales.

ketamine.note: Prescription/veterinary medicine and a controlled psychotropic. Without a prescription: small amount = misdemeanour, more is a crime.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is listed. Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine; more is a crime (up to 2 yrs).

dxm.note: Not a controlled drug (explicitly excluded). Some cough products are sold in pharmacies; higher-strength tablets are prescription-only since 2017.

nitrous.note: Not a controlled drug and no specific consumer ban found. EU chemical rules may stop sales of large canisters to the public from Feb 2027.

amphetamines.note: Small amount: misdemeanour. Courts' guide: >1.5 g methamphetamine is a crime. ADHD medicines (e.g. methylphenidate) are prescription-only.

mdma.note: Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine. Above a 'small amount' (courts' guide: a few pills) it is a crime, up to 2 yrs.

cocaine.note: Small amount for own use: misdemeanour fine. Courts' guide: more than about 1 g is a crime (up to 2 yrs).

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; selling or serving alcohol to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is listed and GBL was added in 2025 (industrial products it can't be easily extracted from are exempt). Small amount: misdemeanour. Oxybate is Rx.

opioids.note: Small amount: misdemeanour; courts' guide: >1.5 g heroin is a crime. Morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl etc. are prescription-only.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine. It is not on the Czech controlled-drug lists, so possession without a prescription is not a drug offence.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only and controlled psychotropics. Without a prescription: small amount = misdemeanour, more is a crime.

maois.note: Pharmaceutical MAOIs (e.g. moclobemide) are prescription-only. Harmala alkaloids/Syrian rue are not listed, but DMT in ayahuasca is.

ssris.note: Prescription-only medicines; not controlled drugs, so possession without a prescription is not an offence.
